## Summary

Describe the change and the hardware/runtime behavior it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make syntax-test`
- [ ] Mapper/IRQ/timer fixture tests relevant to this change
- [ ] `make verify-ci` for broad changes
- [ ] Real SGDK build when target/linker behavior changed

## Compatibility claim

State exactly what is newly demonstrated. Do not generalize a synthetic-fixture result into whole-game compatibility without separate evidence.

## ROM/data policy

- [ ] No commercial ROM, copyrighted game asset, save file, or generated commercial-game source is included.
